Kaṭharudropaniṣad,_Kaṭhaśrutyupaniṣad
(or kaNThazruº) the texts bearing these two titles have much in common. The difference between them are: the former begins devA ha vai bhagavantamabruvan before which the latter reads five additional prose passages starting yo'nukrameNa sannyasyati an. also a few more passages in the middle an. with these additions the latter makes up a. additional first khaṇḍa in the beginning. In the metrical part the former is longer an. contains 43 verses whereas the latter, only 7 verses. Kaṭharudra is assigned to Kṛ. Yv. in the Muktikopaniṣad an. by Upaniṣadbrahmendra. Kaṭhaśruti or Kaṇṭhaº is found in collection of Av. Up.. in mss. an. ptd. edns.
In the sequel the mss. are classified an. given under the two titles Kaṭharudra an. Kaṭha (Kaṇṭha) śruti Up.. [Page119-b]
